subject: Lab sprint: ClearPath POC — venue choice, load test runbook, and recording permissions
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpath.io>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Das <priya.d@clearpath.io>, eng-ops@clearpath.io
Date: 2027-05-30T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: ClearPath POC — venue question and attendee list

Hi Mina,

Quick one: we were aiming for an onsite lab sprint on June 3rd but we have a last-minute exec visit that morning. Can we make the session hybrid so a subset joins remotely? Also attaching the attendee list (internal) and a short network contact for our facilities team.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm whether Redwood can support a hybrid room (Zoom + projector) and record the session for internal review.
- Run the prompt routing/load test at the 50 concurrent-user profile we ran in the trial last month — want to validate token cost and tail latency.
- Provide a visitor access template for our security folks.

Thanks — Samir

Attachment: attendee-list.csv
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpath.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearPath POC — venue question and attendee list

Samir — thanks for the heads up. We can support hybrid and recording but need to confirm a couple of operational details. Options below and a proposed plan:

Options (quick):
1) Fully onsite (preferred for load runs) — Redwood brings 1 engineer + 1 infra tech, onsite AV, room with wired network, no recording unless you sign the visitor release.
2) Hybrid (recommended compromise) — onsite lead runs the load; remote attendees join over Zoom; we record the Zoom (requires your permission and a short data handling addendum). Latency numbers may vary slightly for remote participants but server-side metrics unaffected.

Proposed plan for June 3 (if hybrid):
- 08:30–09:00: setup & network check (Jonas leads AV & room access)
- 09:00–11:00: prompt review + routing QA (Karthik leads)
- 11:00–12:30: load validation (50 concurrent profile) — capture per-token cost and p95/p99 latency
- 12:30–13:00: buffer, debrief, and decision on next steps

Action items for ClearPath:
- Confirm attendee who will handle visitor badges and share site-access-form.pdf back to us signed (I attached a template).
- Confirm recording consent (yes/no).
- Share any firewall/egress IPs if your networking team manages traffic.

Attachments: site-access-form.pdf, proposed-room-setup.png

— Mina
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearPath POC — venue question and attendee list

Mina / team — I ran the load profile locally against a staging slice and attached the runbook snippet (load-test-script.sh). Notes:
- For a 50-concurrent profile we should provision 2x c5g-equivalent pod runtime with continuous batching enabled.
- Need a dedicated NAT/public IP if their firewall blocks ephemeral outbound ports.
- If recording is enabled, we'll record only the Zoom session and redact chat logs before uploading.

Room setup notes (from proposed-room-setup.png):
- 1x MUX laptop with wired 1G link to the test subnet
- 1x projector + HDMI -> ensure the laptop has display cloning
- 1x conference microphone (we can supply if they don't have it)

I'll join onsite if we go hybrid.

— Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood
Attachment: load-test-script.sh
From: Priya Das <priya.d@clearpath.io>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpath.io>, eng-ops@clearpath.io
Date: 2027-05-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearPath POC — venue question and attendee list

Mina — thanks, we can do hybrid. A few clarifications from facilities and security:
- We will sign the visitor access form and return it before EOD tomorrow.
- Recording consent: ClearPath agrees to recording the Zoom session for internal training; recordings should be restricted to company employees and deleted after 90 days unless a retention exception is approved.
- Our facilities can provide a conference room with wired access and projector. They asked if Redwood needs any static IPs — we will share firewall rules by EOD.

Attendees (confirmed): Samir (exec), Priya (ops lead), 4 PMs, 2 Eng-ops (listed in attachment).

Best — Priya
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Das <priya.d@clearpath.io>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpath.io>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-01T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final logistics + calendar update (ClearPath POC — June 3)

All — calendar invite updated to reflect hybrid room and the Zoom link (included). Logistics checklist (final):
- Arrival: Redwood team onsite at 08:00 for setup.
- AV: projector + HDMI confirmed; we brought a conference mic just in case.
- Network: ClearPath to add Redwood runtime IPs to the allowlist (see eng-ops@clearpath.io thread).
- Recording: ClearPath consented; recording will be stored on their tenant and shared with Redwood after redaction if requested.
- Attachments sent to ClearPath: site-access-form.pdf (signed copy pending), proposed-room-setup.png, load-test-script.sh

I'll be onsite to do the network check and coordinate badge pickup. If anything changes, flag immediately.

— Jonas
Program Ops, Redwood Inference
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpath.io>, Priya Das <priya.d@clearpath.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-01T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final logistics + calendar update (ClearPath POC — June 3)

Samir / Priya — appreciate the quick confirmation. I added a short preflight checklist in the Drive folder (link in related_links) with step-by-step test commands Karthik will run during the load window. Please return the signed site-access-form.pdf by EOD tomorrow so facilities can issue visitor badges in advance.

See you Wednesday — we will be conservative on interrupts during the prompt runs and keep a 30-minute buffer before the exec walkthrough.

— Mina
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
